map.基于带状疱疹急性期已知危险因素，评估发展为带状疱疹后神经痛（PHN）的风险，辅助: Based on known acute-phase risk factors for herpes zoster, assess the risk of developing postherpetic neuralgia (PHN) to support early antiviral and analgesic intervention decisions.
map.带状疱疹后神经痛 PHN 风险评分 = 年龄 + 急性疼痛程度 + 前驱痛 +: PHN risk score = age + acute pain severity + prodromal pain + rash severity + immune status + ocular involvement + diabetes + sex, summed; total ≤3 is low risk, ≤7 is moderate risk, >7 is high risk.

map.发疹72小时内启动抗病毒治疗（伐昔洛韦/泛昔洛韦/阿昔洛韦）可缩短病程、降低PH: Starting antiviral therapy within 72 hours of rash onset (valacyclovir / famciclovir / acyclovir) shortens the course and lowers PHN risk. High-risk PHN populations should start neuropathic-pain drugs early (gabapentin / pregabalin), and shingles vaccination is encouraged to prevent recurrence.
map.本工具为基于文献危险因素的风险评估模型，非诊断标准。PHN定义为皮疹愈合后疼痛持: This tool is a risk-assessment model based on literature risk factors, not a diagnostic standard. PHN is defined as pain persisting ≥3 months after rash healing.

map.干预提示：提示发病 72h 内抗病毒、镇痛与神经保护可降低 PHN 概率，持续疼: Intervention tips: prompt that antiviral, analgesia, and nerve protection within 72h of onset lower PHN probability; those with persistent pain should see a pain clinic early.
map.示例：68 岁、急性期疼痛 VAS 8、躯干多发水疱 → 工具评为 PHN 高风: Example: 68 years old, acute-phase pain VAS 8, multiple trunk bullae → tool grades PHN high risk; advise early sufficient antiviral + analgesia and follow up whether pain exceeds 3 months.
